name: TVG_refined_benchmark
description: A benchmark for temporal video grounding that evaluates a model's ability to localize a natural-language query in untrimmed video segments using refined annotations and standardized splits. It focuses on precise temporal localization and retrieval performance under more accurate/refined labels than earlier TVG sets. The benchmark is intended for evaluating multimodal models that handle both video and text inputs.
reputation: A niche research benchmark used in the temporal video grounding community; moderately recognized in multimedia research.
